instellingen.ondertitel: Manage your preferences, security and account.

autoLock.beschrijving: Automatically lock the app after a period of inactivity. You will receive a warning 30 seconds before locking.

groteTekst.beschrijving: Enlarge text throughout the application for better readability.

dashboardWeergave.beschrijving: Choose which sections are visible on your dashboard.

actualisatie.beschrijving: Regularly check if your data is still up to date. Lumio reminds you every quarter (90 days) per section.

profielen.beschrijving: Manage profiles for yourself and your loved ones. Each profile has its own encrypted database. Maximum 5 profiles.

wachtwoord.beschrijving: Change your master password. After changing, the database will be re-encrypted with the new password.
wachtwoord.teKort: Password must contain at least 8 characters.
wachtwoord.wijzigenMislukt: Failed to change password. Check your current password.

backup.beschrijving: Create a backup of your encrypted database or restore a previous backup.
backup.downloadBeschrijving: Download an encrypted ZIP file with your complete database. Store this file in a safe location.
backup.herstelBeschrijving: Restore a previous backup. This replaces all current data. You need the password of the backup.
backup.wachtwoordPlaceholder: Password used to encrypt the backup
backup.hersteld: Backup restored. You will be redirected to the unlock screen.

autoBackup.beschrijving: Configure automatic backups to a folder on your computer or USB drive.

beveiliging.beschrijving: Information about the security of your data.
beveiliging.handtekeningBeschrijving: Generate a unique hash of your current data. This allows you to later verify that your data has not been modified.

overLumio.beschrijving: Lumio is a tool for recording your digital legacy. All data is stored locally and encrypted.
overLumio.juridisch: A notarial will remains required for legal validity under the Dutch Civil Code (BW Book 4).

verwijderen.beschrijving: Permanently delete your entire database. This cannot be undone. Create a backup first if you want to keep your data.
verwijderen.succes: All data has been deleted. You will be redirected...

herstel.beschrijving: Are you sure? This replaces all current data with the data from the backup. This action cannot be undone.

verwijderAlles.beschrijving: Are you sure? All data will be permanently deleted. This includes your profile, passwords, documents, will data and all other stored information. This action cannot be undone.

verwijderProfiel.beschrijving: Are you sure? The profile and its associated database will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
